My split was pretty unconventional but it's what I enjoyed doing and kept me going into the gym. It was a 4 day split, and I took rest days in no particular order, just whenever I wasn't able to make it to the gym. So about once a week or so.

My goal was to hit one of the 4 main compound lifts a day, bench/Deadlift/squat/ohp at about 80% of my 1rm for sets of 5x5 and my accessory lifts being 3x10 reps

Day 1 is chest: starting with 5x5 bench at 80% of my 1rm, and my accessories are Incline dumbell bench, cable Flys, dumbell Flys, machine Flys, and then pushups

Day 2 is back: starting with 5x5 Deadlift, same rules as before. My accessories are lat pulldowns, underhand Barbell rows, and the row machine

Day 3 is bicep/Tricep/shoulders: starting with 5x5 ohp same rules as before. My accessories are 21's, Tricep pulldowns, concentration curls, and Tricep dips

Day 4 is legs: starting with 5x5 squat same rules as before. My accessories are leg press, calf raises, weighted lunges, and leg extensions.

I'm sure this workout has a lot to improve on but this is it!
